newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE JULY GOV'T DEFICIT DOWN TO $198.6 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE JULY GOV'T DEFICIT DOWN TO $198.6 MLN.

text.p: Argentina's central government deficit was $198.6 million in July, compared with $788.7 million in the same month last year, the treasury department of the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
In a statement, the treasury department said revenues rose $601 million from June last year, mainly thanks to income from the sale of shares in oil company YPF valued at $394 million.
Total expenditure, meanwhile, rose just $10.9 million from July a year earlier, to $1.98 billion.
